title: Private World Cup Sightseeing Tour of Atlanta Lunch at Ponce City
blurb: Go sightseeing through Atlanta and experience the city’s rich history, vibrant culture, and iconic landmarks with a knowledgeable local guide leading the way. This tour takes you through some of Atlanta’s most celebrated neighborhoods, from the upscale elegance of Buckhead to the artistic energy of Midtown and the historic heart of downtown. Along the journey, you’ll learn about Atlanta’s deep cultural roots, its role in the Civil Rights Movement, and its rise as a major center for film, food, and entertainment. Additional highlights include passing the World of Coca‑Cola, Georgia Aquarium, Centennial Olympic Park, and the impressive Mercedes‑Benz Stadium—home of the Falcons and a perfect spot for photos. Midday, enjoy lunch at your own expense and browse the shops at Ponce City Market, one of Atlanta’s most popular destinations for food, retail, and local culture. Experience Atlanta’s booming metropolis from a unique perspective.
